list.label: A combo's own page: how many pairs it shows
list.help: The page of one auto colour-pair rule (/combos/<its link>). seeAllOver: past this many pairs the page shows only the first ones with "See all". firstShown: how many show before "See all". bigListShown: the big cards (template L4) show this many before "Show more". builderCard: the "Pick your own colours" card in the grid.

preview.label: Preview links for the combo templates
preview.help: On: a link ending in ?tpl=L2 (or P3 on a combo's page, ?btpl=B4 on the bag) shows that template, so you can look at each one before you choose it. It changes nothing for anyone else, and such a page is hidden from search engines. Off: the links show the template you chose.

pairPage.label: A combo pair page (templates P1–P5): what it shows
pairPage.help: otherPairs: how many other colour pairs of the same style the pair page (P1) shows under it (0 hides the row). packSwatches: how many packs the fixed-pack page (P5) shows as colour circles before "All N packs". upsell: "Make it 3 pcs" on the pair page, when the rule offers a 3-piece set of the same product.
